properties.name: button_extent
properties.comment: The arrow buttons' extent along the axis, 8 to 64 pixels (else std::invalid_argument).
prepare: require_finite(incoming, "scrollbar button extent must be finite");
if (incoming < 8.0 || incoming > 64.0) throw std::invalid_argument("scrollbar button extent must be between 8 and 64");

properties.name: minimum_thumb_extent
properties.comment: The thumb's least extent, 8 to 128 pixels (else std::invalid_argument).
prepare: require_finite(incoming, "scrollbar thumb extent must be finite");
if (incoming < scroll_thumb_extent_least || incoming > scroll_thumb_extent_most) throw std::invalid_argument("scrollbar thumb extent must be between 8 and 128");

properties.name: initial_repeat_delay
properties.comment: How long a held part waits before it repeats, 100ms to 2s (else std::invalid_argument); a press already repeating keeps its schedule.
hand: prepare: the 100ms to 2s check; written: nothing to invalidate

properties.name: repeat_interval
properties.comment: The interval between a held part's repeats, 16ms to 500ms (else std::invalid_argument).
hand: prepare: the 16ms to 500ms check; written: nothing to invalidate
